description: This file defines a MapStruct interface, LoanTransactionDataMapper, for mapping LoanTransactionData objects to LoanTransactionDataV1 Avro data objects within the Fineract project. It includes a custom method to determine if a transaction is reversed and configures field mappings, some of which are ignored.

classes.name: LoanTransactionDataMapper
classes.description: A MapStruct mapper interface for converting LoanTransactionData to LoanTransactionDataV1, with specific field mapping configurations and custom logic for determining if a transaction is reversed.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Converts a LoanTransactionData object to a LoanTransactionDataV1 object, ignoring certain fields and using custom logic for the 'reversed' field.

methods.name: isReversed
methods.description: Determines if a given LoanTransactionData object is considered reversed based on manual reversal status or reversal date.
